title: CERT-In Flags AI-Driven Attacks as Backdoored ARTEX Exposes 62 Consoles to Root Access

Describing the threat as active and ongoing, the activity involves the use of publicly-available AI-driven offensive security tools

title: A banking malware sample led researchers to an Android bug that can loop-crash phones
hint: Bitdefender Labs researchers built an Android app that contains no executable code and requests no permissions, and installing it leaves a Pixel 10 in a crash loop that can take a factory reset to clear. The flaw, which Bitdefender calls GhostMap, comes from how Android reads the ZIP structure inside an APK. The app does not need to be opened.
